question: Should the Start Here text list be replaced with dynamic PinMe repository cards despite the added third-party image dependency?
rationale: VISION.md explicitly reserves profile editorial control and requires external live images to justify their reliability and privacy cost, so owner intent is necessary.

options.title: Keep concise text list
options.body: Retain canonical links and coarse star thresholds without adding another live image service.

options.title: Pilot PinMe cards
options.body: Adopt a limited card set only after verifying service maintenance, privacy, accessibility, proxy rendering, and fallback behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep concise text list
recommendation.body: Retain canonical links and coarse star thresholds without adding another live image service.

likelyOwner.reason: VISION.md assigns profile editorial control to Peter, and README history shows him repeatedly curating this surface.
